## 6. Noise and Vibration

### 6.1 Sound Power Level

Sound power measurements are taken in the Aurora Appliances acoustics lab (NATA-accredited test method based on ISO 3744) with the blender operating on a hard surface at 230 V, 50 Hz. Values are expressed as A-weighted sound power level (LWA) in decibels, with measurement uncertainty ±2 dB.

### 6.2 Vibration at the Base

Vibration is measured at the four rubber feet using a piezoelectric accelerometer. Reported values are the maximum single-axis RMS acceleration during a 30-second run at the stated speed.

| Operating Mode | Max RMS Acceleration (m/s²) |
|---|---|
| Speed 1 (stir) | 0.4 |
| Speed 5 (typical blend) | 1.6 |
| Speed 10 (maximum) | 3.1 |
| Crush preset | 2.8 |

### 6.3 Noise Reduction Notes

- The jar is fitted with a silicone gasket between the blade assembly and the jar base; this reduces high-frequency blade noise by approximately 3 dB compared with the earlier C2 model.
- The BLDC motor itself contributes less than 35 dB at speed 5; most radiated noise comes from air movement through the jar vents and blade cavitation.
- The base housing includes 4 mm of recycled EVA foam around the motor cavity. This material also provides thermal insulation, keeping the outer surface below 40 °C during continuous operation.
- For quiet operation, users can select the "Stir" preset, which ramps the motor over 5 seconds to speed 2 and holds it there for 20 seconds before stopping. This mode is recommended for adding ingredients while the unit is running.

---

## 7. Jar, Lid, and Accessories

### 7.1 Jar Construction

The C3 is supplied with one 2.0 L Tritan™ copolyester jar (model JB-2L-C3). The jar has a graduated scale in millilitres and cups on the front face, printed with solvent-free ink. The base of the jar is a separate polypropylene collar that is ultrasonically welded to the Tritan™ body; this collar houses the blade assembly and the sealing ring.

### 7.2 Blade Assembly

- Blade material: Stainless steel (grade 420), hardened and tempered.
- Blade configuration: 4 blades, two at a 20° upward angle and two at a 35° downward angle, arranged in a stacked pair.
- Blade mount: The blades are pressed onto a hexagonal drive shaft; the shaft is held in place by a retaining clip that can be removed for cleaning.
- Blade replacement: The blade assembly (model BA-C3) is a user-replaceable part. Replacement instructions are included in the user manual. The blade assembly is not dishwasher-safe; the sealing ring must be removed before washing.

### 7.3 Lid and Measuring Cup

- The lid is a single-piece polypropylene moulding with a central removable measuring cup (capacity 60 mL).
- The measuring cup has a double-wall construction to reduce spillage when ingredients are added during operation.
- The lid seal is a food-grade silicone ring that is retained in a groove around the lid perimeter. The seal is replaceable (part LR-C3).
- The lid is not airtight. A small vent hole in the measuring cup allows steam to escape when blending hot ingredients (max 80 °C).

The inspection found the manufacturer to be in general compliance with the requirements of AS/NZS 60335.2.14:2020. No critical non-conformities were identified during the inspection period.

## 6. Noise and Vibration

### 6.1 Sound Power Level

Sound power measurements are taken in the Aurora Appliances acoustics lab (NATA-accredited test method based on ISO 3744) with the blender operating on a hard surface at 230 V, 50 Hz. Values are expressed as A-weighted sound power level (LWA) in decibels, with measurement uncertainty ±2 dB.

| Operating Mode | LWA (dB) |
|---|---|
| Speed 1 (stir) | 58 |
| Speed 5 (typical blend) | 72 |
| Speed 10 (maximum) | 81 |
| Crush preset | 79 |
| Self-clean preset | 68 |

### 6.2 Vibration at the Base

Vibration is measured at the four rubber feet using a piezoelectric accelerometer. Reported values are the maximum single-axis RMS acceleration during a 30-second run at the stated speed.

| Operating Mode | Max RMS Acceleration (m/s²) |
|---|---|
| Speed 1 (stir) | 0.4 |
| Speed 5 (typical blend) | 1.6 |
| Speed 10 (maximum) | 3.1 |
| Crush preset | 2.8 |

### 6.3 Noise Reduction Notes

- The jar is fitted with a silicone gasket between the blade assembly and the jar base; this reduces high-frequency blade noise by approximately 3 dB compared with the earlier C2 model.
- The BLDC motor itself contributes less than 35 dB at speed 5; most radiated noise comes from air movement through the jar vents and blade cavitation.
- The base housing includes 4 mm of recycled EVA foam around the motor cavity. This material also provides thermal insulation, keeping the outer surface below 40 °C during continuous operation.
- For quiet operation, users can select the "Stir" preset, which ramps the motor over 5 seconds to speed 2 and holds it there for 20 seconds before stopping. This mode is recommended for adding ingredients while the unit is running.

---

## 7. Jar, Lid, and Accessories

### 7.1 Jar Construction

The C3 is supplied with one 2.0 L Tritan™ copolyester jar (model JB-2L-C3). The jar has a graduated scale in millilitres and cups on the front face, printed with solvent-free ink. The base of the jar is a separate polypropylene collar that is ultrasonically welded to the Tritan™ body; this collar houses the blade assembly and the sealing ring.

### 7.2 Blade Assembly

- Blade material: Stainless steel (grade 420), hardened and tempered.
- Blade configuration: 4 blades, two at a 20° upward angle and two at a 35° downward angle, arranged in a stacked pair.
- Blade mount: The blades are pressed onto a hexagonal drive shaft; the shaft is held in place by a retaining clip that can be removed for cleaning.
- Blade replacement: The blade assembly (model BA-C3) is a user-replaceable part. Replacement instructions are included in the user manual. The blade assembly is not dishwasher-safe; the sealing ring must be removed before washing.

### 7.3 Lid and Measuring Cup

- The lid is a single-piece polypropylene moulding with a central removable measuring cup (capacity 60 mL).
- The measuring cup has a double-wall construction to reduce spillage when ingredients are added during operation.
- The lid seal is a food-grade silicone ring that is retained in a groove around the lid perimeter. The seal is replaceable (part LR-C3).
- The lid is not airtight. A small vent hole in the measuring cup allows steam to escape when blending hot ingredients (max 80 °C).
